# Booking.com

3 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit), 1 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/booking/hotel - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Booking.com property's catalogue record: address, coordinates, star rating, photos, amenities and the check-in and check-out windows. It does not price a stay (GET /v1/booking/search does) and Booking.com leaves its headline review score out of this record, so place.rating.value and place.reviews_count are null here; the search row and GET /v1/booking/hotel/reviews carry them.

**Use when** you want it for property details. It does not price a stay and carries no review score, which search and hotel/reviews do.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Booking.com property id as GET /v1/booking/search returns it in place.id, for example pt/masa-5-de-outubro. Send id or url. · e.g. `pt/masa-5-de-outubro`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Booking.com property link, for example https://www.booking.com/hotel/pt/masa-5-de-outubro.html.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Place` object at `data`, `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/Place.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.image_urls` | Image URL, or a list of image URLs, for the place. |
| `place.latitude` | Latitude in decimal degrees. |

+13 more (types in the full schema): `place` {longitude, reviews_count}; `place.ext` {city, country_code, category_ratings, languages_spoken, rooms}; `place.hotel` {amenities, check_in_time, check_out_time, stars}; `place.rating` {max, value}. Never filled: `place.category`, `place.description`, `place.phone`, `place.price_level`, `place.verified`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/booking/hotel" \
  --data-urlencode "id=pt/masa-5-de-outubro" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/booking/hotel/reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns a Booking.com property's guest reviews, up to 25 a page, each with its score out of 10, title, what the guest liked and disliked (both kept in review.text, labelled), language, date, the guest's name and country (review.author.location) and the property's reply. data.total is the property's full review count. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to learn why guests rate a property the way they do. The total review count comes back too.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free. With `max_pages`, `max_items` or `max_credits`, each page walked is billed at this price (a cached page is free), and `max_credits` caps the total.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · default page size not measured; set with `limit` · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The Booking.com property id as GET /v1/booking/search returns it in place.id, for example pt/masa-5-de-outubro. Send id or url. · e.g. `pt/masa-5-de-outubro`
- `url` (optional, string) - A Booking.com property link, for example https://www.booking.com/hotel/pt/masa-5-de-outubro.html.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-25) - Reviews to return, 1 to 25. Default 25.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` (1) · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality); `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.
- `reports`, `label_evidence` are no-ops without `label` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `goal`, `fit_tokens` are no-ops without `fit` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `label`: at most 5 comma-separated values.

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.title` | Review headline. |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `review.author.name` | Reviewer name. |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |

+17 more (types in the full schema): `review` {entity_id, helpful_votes, language, responses}; `computed.labels` {incentivized, injection, issue, reports, sentiment}; `review.author` {location}; `review.rating` {max, value}; `review.ext` {room_type, stay_check_in, stay_check_out, stay_nights, traveler_type}. Never filled: `review.author.avatar_url`, `review.author.reviews_count`, `review.author.url`, `review.images`, `review.original_language`, `review.source`, `review.translated`, `review.url`, `review.verified`. Page-level: `data.category_ratings`, `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/booking/hotel/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "id=pt/masa-5-de-outubro" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/booking/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns about 25 Booking.com properties a page for a destination, each with its address, coordinates, star rating, review score out of 10 and count, photos, and every bookable room option priced in place.hotel.prices (meal plan and free-cancellation date in each row's title). Without check_in and check_out the search prices a default stay, echoed back in data.check_in and data.check_out. Booking.com repeats properties across pages; each page leaves out any property an earlier page of the same walk already served, and data._warnings says how many. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to compare hotels and room prices in a city. Add check_in and check_out for your dates, or you get a default stay.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · page size not measured · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `location` (required) - A destination, for example Lisbon. · e.g. `Lisbon`
- `check_in` (optional, string) - Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with check_out.
- `check_out` (optional, string) - Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with check_in.
- `adults` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Adults, 1 to 30.
- `children` (optional, integer, 0-10) - Children, 0 to 10.
- `rooms` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Rooms, 1 to 30.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block, passed back with the same parameters. Omit for the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.image_urls` | Image URL, or a list of image URLs, for the place. |
| `place.latitude` | Latitude in decimal degrees. |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `place` {longitude, reviews_count}; `place.ext` {city, country_code, listing_badges}; `place.hotel` {prices, stars}; `place.rating` {max, value}. Never filled: `place.category`, `place.description`, `place.phone`, `place.price_level`, `place.verified`. Page-level: `data.check_in`, `data.check_out`, `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/booking/search" \
  --data-urlencode "location=Lisbon" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
